narrative.headline: 2022 Tesla Model 3: driver-assist complaints dominate
narrative.summary: Owners filed 742 complaints with NHTSA. Forward collision avoidance is by far the most reported area at 70%, well ahead of vehicle speed control and service brakes (both 23%). No deaths are reported. Service brakes carry the most injuries (12) and are tied with forward collision avoidance for the most crashes (14), and the electrical system is the only area with reported fires (3), so both are worth a close look on a test drive.
